content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Issue:** § 2.2 (p0013) makes Silverline our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — unlimited-duration exclusive dealing with no category narrowing and no performance-based exit, which is the playbook walk-away position.
- **Internal conflict:** It contradicts § 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment and is free to engage any supplier).
- **Direction check:** The restraint binds us, not Silverline, so it is not the acceptable "exclusivity in Customer's favour" pattern.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Delete § 2.2 entirely; fallback offered in the comment is category-limited, 12-month exclusivity terminating automatically on service-level or delivery failure.
